backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor providing access control, user profiles, story submission, comments, reviews, and system info with pending and published story storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking verification feature to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files describing their purpose and behavior.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining canister roles, usage of frontend canister ID, and deployment/troubleshooting steps.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and theme tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining root mount point and linking favicon, touch icon, and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup registering all application routes and wrapping pages in AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component showing access-denied messaging with login prompts, principal diagnostics, and navigation buttons.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header component with navigation links, admin visibility logic, and Internet Identity login/logout handling.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Defines the main page layout with header, content area, and footer including navigation and contact info.
frontend/src/components/BackendHeartbeat: Provides a diagnostics UI to check backend availability and display reachability status with alerts.
Form component for submitting comments, handling input, validation, and submission state.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Fetches and displays a list of comments for a story with timestamps and loading states.
frontend/src/components/CommentThreadDis: Shows discussion comments for a story using aggregated discussions data with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Displays canister IDs and URLs with copy actions for troubleshooting deployment issues.
frontend/src/components/ReviewComposer.t: Form for adding a review with star rating, optional name, and optional text, managing submission state.
frontend/src/components/ReviewThread.tsx: Displays a review thread for a story, handling loading, empty states, and rendering formatted reviews with ratings and timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides admin-specific queries and mutations for checking admin status and managing pending or published stories.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Checks backend canister availability via a heartbeat call and returns reachability state and error info.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Fetches all discussions and provides a mutation to add new reviews, invalidating discussion data on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook managing authentication, identity persistence, and login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Handles fetching published stories, single stories, comments, submissions, and provides mutations to submit stories or comments.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes with editorial typography enhancements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page with author background, platform purpose, and contact info.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Provides an admin interface to review, publish, create, and delete stories and articles with authentication and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single published article with metadata and supports viewing and adding comments.
frontend/src/pages/ArticlesPage.tsx: Lists all published articles with loading and error states and links to individual article pages.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Shows author contact details, book info, and social media links.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays discussion topics with tabs for comments and reviews, allowing users to browse and engage in threads.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Fetches and displays published stories with error handling, backend availability diagnostics, and retry options.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and navigation buttons for reading, submitting stories, and logging in.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Handles Internet Identity authentication, showing login state, errors, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/MySubmissionsPage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's story submissions with status, loading states, and login prompts.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Shows a single published story with metadata and includes a comment composer and thread.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Page component for submitting a story with authentication handling, form validation, and submission states.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: Troubleshooting page explaining canister resolution issues and showing canister info with copy helpers and backend heartbeat checks.
frontend/src/utils/authErrors.ts: Provides helpers to detect unauthorized and connectivity errors and generate user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Utility for resolving frontend and backend canister IDs and generating related URLs for troubleshooting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project status, existing features, and new feature requests related to finalizing access control and preparing for production deployment. Contains versioning, readiness summary, and pending action items for backend behavior and build/deployment.
